contracts: (Account fixture receives deny and records an independent witness while all non-account inputs are unchanged.) AND (Fixture observes rejection and unchanged-input assertion passes.) AND (No processing occurs and rejection cites the mismatched authority/path pair.) AND (Rejection is recorded and input snapshot comparison proves all non-feature inputs are unchanged.) AND (The isolated runtime fixture reports rejection and confirms the target runtime file is unchanged.)
selector_intents: Execute the Windows/profile fixture with intentionally mismatched authority and path and assert deterministic rejection.
Invoke the feature-fixture guard with a Miner/Curator request and verify rejection while all other inputs remain unchanged.
Run the isolated protected-path fixture; fail if the validator accepts a write to any protected BMAD/GDS path.
Run the protected-path fixture with input-hash comparison; fail if any non-target input differs.
Select the account-write fixture and verify the governance decision is deny; any allow, changed non-account input, or missing witness fails.
Select the runtime fixture with a write request and require failure if the guard permits or persists the runtime mutation.
